Welcome to Pawnee County
Official Website of Pawnee County in Nebraska. Your source for Information about Pawnee County Offices, Departments and Services.
Cities and villages include: Pawnee City, Burchard, Du Bois, Lewiston, Steinauer, Table Rock

TALK TO US
Have any questions or concerns? We are always ready to work with you and are available to assist with any county services.
GET IN TOUCH
BOARD MEETINGS
Join us at County Board of Commissioners meetings to influence decisions that impact our community. Your voice matters in shaping policies for a better future together.
VIEW BOARD DOCUMENTS
EMPLOYMENT
Explore our employment page today and discover exciting opportunities to join our team. Take the next step in your career with us!
APPLY NOW
REQUESTS FOR BIDDING
Visit our Requests for Bids page now to explore opportunities for collaboration. Submit your bid and partner with us to deliver excellence together.
